intro: The Talisman of Corruption is a vile demonic trinket used by the satyr Xabraxxis to poison the minds of Darkshore's Blackwood furbolgs. Carried within the satyr's personal pouch, it serves as a magical conduit that binds the tribe to fel madness.

p: The night elves of Auberdine have long struggled to understand why the Blackwood furbolgs turned so aggressively upon their former allies. Thundris Windweaver discovered that the tribe's downfall was not a natural descent, but deliberate sabotage orchestrated by the satyrs. Using talismans like this one, demonic agents project corrupting sorcery across the wilderness, tainting food supplies and twisting peaceful forest spirits into frenzied beasts. By channeling fell magics directly through these devices, the satyrs hold an unbroken grip over the minds and wills of the local tribes.
